title: triumfetta pilosa var. effusa
intro: Triumfetta pilosa var. effusa, commonly known as White Milkweed or Tumbleweed, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family, characterized by its sprawling habit and small, white flowers. The plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Triumfetta pilosa var. effusa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
